summary: Export writer loan and batch hold ages, bounded holder origins, and Tokio runtime lag

replay.detail: Telemetry only; no replay or projection changes.

schema.detail: No persisted schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: Writer admission, loans, transactions and acknowledgements are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Adds st.db.writer.hold and st.db.writer.current_hold in seconds with bounded st.db.writer.origin and db.system.name attributes, and st.runtime.lag in seconds without instrument attributes. Writer queue duration gains the same origin attribute. Wait and hold histogram finite buckets reach 600 seconds; consumers aggregating queue duration must aggregate across origins. Storage phase spans remain opt-in.

manual.detail: Existing OTLP metrics configuration exports the new instruments.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback restores prior telemetry without changing durable state.
